findings.evidence: `alias windingNumber_modelSector := indexIntegral_arc` occurs at Circle.lean:125; the alias statement at lines 116–119 is only a normalized integral of `circleMap`, whereas Closed.lean:144–147 proves `windingNumber (modelSector ...) ... = α/(2π)`.
findings.fix: Give the closed-curve theorem the canonical name `windingNumber_modelSector`; do not retain the misleading old alias under that name (or, if compatibility is mandatory, give the closed theorem another concise name that still identifies the closed model sector).
findings.issue: The deprecated `windingNumber_modelSector` alias denotes `indexIntegral_arc`, whose statement contains no `modelSector`, while the actual result is named the unnecessarily RHS-specific `windingNumber_modelSector_eq_div_two_pi` at `ModelSector/Closed.lean:144`. summary: The canonical model-sector theorem name remains attached to an arc integral rather than the newly introduced model-sector curve.
